summary: Legend Biotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 15, 2026, announcing U.S. FDA clearance of an Investigational New Drug application for LB2501, an investigational in vivo CD19/CD20 dual-targeting CAR-T therapy for relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancies. The clearance supports a planned U.S. Phase 1/2 study evaluating safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and preliminary efficacy. No financial terms, securities, shareholder vote, advisor, or transaction mechanics are involved. This is a routine clinical/regulatory milestone disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation; risk-arb relevance is nil.
